chk_media_dimensions_valid.name: chk_media_dimensions_valid
chk_media_dimensions_valid.value: ("media_assets"."width" IS NULL OR "media_assets"."width" > 0) AND ("media_assets"."height" IS NULL OR "media_assets"."height" > 0)

chk_enquiries_budget_non_negative.name: chk_enquiries_budget_non_negative
chk_enquiries_budget_non_negative.value: ("enquiries"."budget_min" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."budget_min" >= 0) AND ("enquiries"."budget_max" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."budget_max" >= 0)

chk_budget_range_valid.name: chk_budget_range_valid
chk_budget_range_valid.value: "enquiries"."budget_min" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."budget_max" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."budget_min" <= "enquiries"."budget_max"

chk_budget_currency_required.name: chk_budget_currency_required
chk_budget_currency_required.value: ("enquiries"."budget_min" IS NULL AND "enquiries"."budget_max" IS NULL) OR ("enquiries"."budget_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
